answer: Harbor clerks refuse a night berth based on a copied photo. The claimant posts 19.5 POA and has 28 minutes to moor skiff SK-6 at reef ring RR-12, drape velvet sleeve VS-09 over bollard B-7 so a 14 cm nap faces camera C-4, and seat crystal rod CR-18 in the 8 mm pocket until meter LX-2 holds 41.6 lux for 70 seconds. A second skiff from the same cluster, a lux miss above 1.5, or a reused sleeve burns the 19.5 POA and cancels berth rights for four epochs. Two dock judges rehash the sleeve lot and lux tape.
